description:
Here at Byrne Malone we love unique homes and we are delighted to present this stunning residence at Robertstown to the market by private Treaty. 

Welcome to this breath-taking detached family home, set on circa 3 acres of picturesque land with unrivalled views. Step inside to a grand, tiled hallway leading to a beautifully designed sitting room and an impressive open-plan kitchen, dining, and living space. This stunning area boasts vaulted ceilings, timber beams, and a stove burner, perfect for creating a warm and inviting atmosphere on cosy nights. The tiled flooring throughout adds elegance, while the spacious utility room provides ample storage for effortless organization.

This home also offers a dedicated office space, a convenient downstairs WC, and 5 generously sized bedrooms, three of which feature en-suite bathrooms. Upstairs, a converted attic bedroom and a large storage area add even more versatility to this incredible property that could easily make 2 or 3 more bedrooms or office space.

Outside, this exceptional property continues to impress with manicured gardens and a spacious patio, perfect for outdoor entertaining and soaking in the breathtaking surroundings. A large timber shed and aluminium workshop/storage space provide practical solutions for organization and storage needs. The gated entrance ensures security and privacy, creating a secluded retreat for peaceful living.

This home seamlessly blends luxury, functionality, and tranquillity, making it an ideal haven. 

A perfect blend of charm, space, and modern conveniencesâ€”this exceptional home is ready to welcome its new owners.

Situated in a quiet rural area close to Robertstown Village and 4 minutes drive to Prosperous village, 10 minutes to Clane twenty minute drive to Naas and a ten minute drive to Caragh Village. The M7 is twenty minutes away and the M4 is just thirty minutes away. VIEWING IS A MUST.
